_doc: Simulation instance: 24 practice straight-path driving scenarios, 8 held out. Reward = fraction of 4 oracles passed per episode; S = mean reward over 24 x k trials. Cost per trial = policy tokens + sim_second_tokens x simulated seconds. delta is null so `calibrate` estimates it from repeated base evaluations. Engine: RRSI_SIM_ENGINE (fake | cpu | carla).
